CHECK BURST CS-asm-fg-v4-band6 — composite Astra's repainted canyon-facing CLOUD EDGES (painted over pure black) into the cloud-band foreground, recovering translucent wisps by known-background matting (Matt R-C3-75/76). REPORT ONLY. FIX over band5: faint lighter HAZE PATCHES appeared inside the cloud bank where edited tiles were crossfaded (the edit re-rendered interior clouds slightly lighter/softer). task_id "CS-asm-fg-v4-band6".

Inputs (read-only): BASE /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-asm-fg-v4-band3/foreground.png (5376×4096 RGBA, straight alpha: ground, rock and the cloud band); depth /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v4/ortho_canvas_v4_depth_mm.png (uint16 mm; 0 top surfaces; 65535 not foreground); tiles /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-edge-canvases/edge_tiles.json (id, x, y; each 1536×1024); for each tile the ORIGINAL canvas /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-edge-canvases/edge_<id>_canvas.png (BASE premultiplied over black) and the EDITED image /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-edge-<id>/edge_<id>.png (same crop over black with repainted cloud edges). python glue PIL/numpy/scipy; no new tool files.

Definitions in level px: a0 = BASE alpha/255. VOID = depth 65535; DEEP = 9000 < depth < 65535; ROCKVIS = pixels that are not VOID with a0 ≥ 0.5 and NOT cloud (rock or top ground visible: depth ≤ 9000, or DEEP pixels whose BASE colour is rock — define cloud0 = a0 ≥ 0.5 ∧ (VOID ∨ DEEP ∧ depth > 8000) as BASE cloud). EDGE0 = cloud0 pixels within 2 px of a VOID pixel with a0 < 0.5.
STEP 1 — per tile, REGION R = pixels within 150 px (Euclidean) of EDGE0, restricted to (VOID ∪ cloud0), minus TOP (depth 0) and minus depth ≤ 9000 faces. Weight w = 1 for pixels within 60 px of EDGE0, falling with a smoothstep to 0 at 150 px from EDGE0 (the ramp lies inside the bank, so any residual tone difference fades gradually). Across tiles, normalise overlapping weights by their sum (linear crossfade); pixels outside every R keep BASE unchanged.
STEP 2 — MATTING of each EDITED tile E against black: m = max(R,G,B)/255 of E; reference opacity-colour level Fm = grey-dilation (disc radius 24 px) of m computed ONLY over pixels whose ORIGINAL canvas had BASE cloud0 with a0 ≥ 0.99 and lying ≥ 30 px inside cloud0 — then filled outward to every pixel by nearest-neighbour; alpha_e = clip(m / max(Fm, 0.25), 0, 1); smoothstep(0.03, 0.97, alpha_e); colour_e = E / max(alpha_e, 0.02) clipped to 255. Pixels whose E is pure black within 6/255 → alpha_e 0.
STEP 2b — TONE MATCH each edited tile to BASE before compositing: over pixels of the tile that are BASE cloud0 with a0 ≥ 0.99 and ≥ 30 px inside cloud0 AND whose edited alpha_e ≥ 0.95, compute per-channel low-frequency gain G = Gaussian(σ=40 px, BASE premultiplied RGB) / Gaussian(σ=40 px, edited colour_e), using normalized convolution (divide by the blurred mask) so only valid pixels contribute; fill G outward by nearest-neighbour, clip G to [0.8, 1.25]; colour_e ← colour_e × G. Report per tile the mean |G − 1| before clipping.
STEP 3 — COMPOSITE the cloud in R: for VOID pixels, cloud = lerp_premultiplied(BASE, (colour_e, alpha_e), w); for DEEP pixels, final alpha = max(a0, lerp(a0, alpha_e, w)) and colour = lerp_premultiplied(BASE, edited over BASE, w) (never reduce cover over rock). Then FORCE: DEEP pixels with depth > 15000 alpha 1; DEEP pixels within 3 px of a VOID pixel with final alpha < 0.5 must have alpha ≥ 0.95 (set it, colour from the nearest cloud pixel); TOP pixels exactly BASE.
STEP 4 — CHECKS: (a) DEEP depth > 13000 with final alpha < 0.95 (target 0); (b) exposed underside count (DEEP within 3 px of low-alpha VOID with alpha < 0.95) (target 0); (c) mean |FINAL − BASE| RGBA over pixels with depth ≤ 9000 and TOP (target 0) ; (d) per tile: fraction of R whose |E − ORIGINAL| > 30 (how much Astra changed), and the same fraction for pixels OUTSIDE R (Astra changes to rock/ground that were NOT used) — report both; (e) alpha histogram of VOID pixels in R (share in (0.05, 0.95) = translucent wisps); (f) HAZE: over cloud0 interior pixels ≥ 60 px inside the bank and inside some R, mean luminance difference FINAL − BASE (target |·| < 3/255) and the p95 of the same after a 25-px blur (target < 8/255); also report band5's value of the same metric computed from /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-asm-fg-v4-band5/foreground.png for comparison.
STEP 5 — OUTPUTS: out/foreground.png (5376×4096 RGBA), out/foreground_preview_1344x1024.png (over #3a3f4a), out/edge_detail_crops.png (the same 4 crop centres as CS-asm-fg-v4-band4's edge crops if present in /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-asm-fg-v4-band4/checks.json, else the 4 tiles with most EDGE0; each 640×640 over #3a3f4a AND over the median colour of /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-asm-layers/layers/forest_valley.png, 2×4 grid), out/checks.json, out/summary.txt ≤ 14 lines. No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. Deliver within 14 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-asm-fg-v4-band6"; images []; files: every out/ file with sha256; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
